C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for fraction parts.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag for fraction-only or mixed-number items when unlike denominators are reconciled before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple simplification of a fraction such as 4/10 to 2/5 unless it is part of creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more workable equivalent form, such as simplifying a fractional part, converting an improper mixed number, or expressing a whole number with a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag final-answer simplification after subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion; that belongs to equalizing denominators.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional results into the final form.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are expressed with the same denominator, including direct numerator subtraction for like denominators.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already aligned.
Tag when the subtraction yields zero or a negative fractional intermediate.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating the common denominator.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag regrouping/borrowing used to fix a negative fractional result.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the operands when working with mixed numbers or whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number difference is computed alongside fraction-part work in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the whole-part result is zero and later combined with a fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-only items with no whole-number components.
Do not tag the borrowing adjustment step where 1 is taken from the whole part; that belongs to regrouping.
Do not tag final combination of whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part being subtracted is larger than the fractional part available.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units and added to the existing fraction part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional intermediate in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary whole-part subtraction when no borrowing occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion between unlike denominators.
Do not tag final simplification or final combination steps.

skills.name: Simplify and compose
skills.definition: Express the result in lowest terms and in an appropriate final form by combining whole and fractional parts or reducing to an integer or zero when warranted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a reduced fraction is produced from a non-reduced result such as 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when whole and fraction parts are combined into a mixed number or a fraction-only result.
Tag when a result with zero fractional part is written as an integer or when 0/denominator is simplified to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate rewriting of operands before subtraction.
Do not tag the subtraction operations themselves.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including rewriting, borrowing, and simplifying results

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting
Tag for both standalone fraction subtraction and mixed-number fraction-part subtraction with unlike denominators
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of borrowing rather than denominator matching
Do not tag simplification of a fraction to lower terms

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts fractions with the same denominator
Tag after common-denominator conversion if the actual subtraction of the like fractions is shown
Tag when the result is 0 over a denominator before simplification
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps that only find or create a common denominator
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps that prepare for subtraction but do not perform it

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more usable equivalent form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with fractional part 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a mixed-number subtraction setup
Tag only when the rewriting changes the representation of an operand before subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag borrowing from a whole part during subtraction; that is regrouping, not initial normalization
Do not tag finding a common denominator between two non-whole fractions
Do not tag final conversion of an answer to simplest form

skills.name: Subtract mixed parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions when no borrowing is required.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when solution steps separately subtract whole parts and fraction parts and both subtractions are directly valid
Tag when a whole or mixed number minus a fraction is handled by keeping or subtracting the whole part without regrouping
Tag when the fractional subtraction does not require borrowing from the whole part
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractional part becomes negative and a borrow/regroup step is needed
Do not tag pure fraction-only subtraction with no whole-number part involved
Do not tag the final combine step by itself unless the step explicitly performs the partwise subtraction

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue mixed-number subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into d/d or equivalent fractional units
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number subtraction
Tag for cases involving same or unlike denominators once the regrouped fraction is formed
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d before any need to borrow is addressed
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts when no regrouping occurs
Do not tag simplification after subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a mixed number with 0 fractional part is written as an integer
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed-number or integer answer
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction or borrowing steps unless they explicitly simplify or finalize the result form
Do not tag operand normalization before subtraction
Do not tag common-denominator conversion

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fractions with unlike denominators are converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction when only the fractional parts need denominator conversion.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple simplification of a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 after subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part unless a denominator is being chosen to support subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as converting an improper fractional part or adding a 0 fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number's fractional part is simplified before subtraction to make the operand standard or compatible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag borrowing from a whole part during subtraction; that is regrouping, not initial rewriting.
Do not tag conversion to a common denominator between two existing fractions.
Do not tag final simplification of the answer.

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Subtract one fraction from another once they are in compatible form, including same-denominator proper or improper fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when the subtraction produces 0 or a negative intermediate fractional result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding the common denominator itself.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts only.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the quantities when working with mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is handled as the whole-part subtraction in a mixed-number setup.
Tag even if the whole-part result is later adjusted by borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction that involves only fractional numerators.
Do not tag the borrowing step that reduces the whole part by 1; that belongs to regrouping.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction cannot be completed directly.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative or insufficient fractional part in mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having 0 fractional part before any borrowing occurs.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts when no borrowing is needed.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination after regrouping.

skills.name: Compose simplified result
skills.definition: Combine whole and fractional results and express the final answer in lowest terms, including reducing to an integer or proper mixed number when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when a result such as 0/3 or 1 0/8 is simplified to an integer.
Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction steps that produce the unsimplified result.
Do not tag finding a common denominator or rewriting operands before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping itself.
